candidate_topics: FAVE-TS / Applicability-Aware Retrieval for Industrial Time Series
confirmed_findings: PhysicalAI F1 improved pooled fault-detection metrics across seeds 42-44, but effects were fault-specific and normal prediction improvement was inconsistent.
FAVE-RAG's real 10-item pilot detected many invalid evidence items but did not establish a robustness advantage over Vanilla RAG.
open_hypotheses: Historical windows that are similar but differ in operating/control context may be inapplicable references for current industrial diagnosis.
required_experiments: G0 full-text novelty and non-circular applicability-construct gate
Similarity-matched applicable/inapplicable case pilot with agreement audit
Contamination benchmark with strong retrieval and adaptation baselines
Multi-seed, ablation, robustness, and run-level statistical validation
recommended_gate: G0 complete; await user choice among A mechanism gate, richer-dataset reformulation, or topic reset
